task: Two-pair assembly from a demonstration video
task_long: Watch a demonstration video of a person assembling two part pairs, then assemble the same two pairs in the workspace and leave each one stable after release.

video.unit: seconds of run time on the overhead recording; pts = frame index / fps, constant frame rate, starts at 0. The video element runs on video time; see top.time_map.

time_map.definition: video_t = (run_t - encoded_from_s) / speed ; run_t = encoded_from_s + video_t * speed
time_map.note: every time in this file - events, lanes, tokens, chapters - is RUN time on the overhead recording. Convert with this map before seeking the video element.

views_not_shipped.wrist: decision D1: the wrist view is not encoded for the viewer in v1
views_not_shipped.side: decision D1: the side view is not encoded for the viewer in v1

video.playable_note: the encode stops a few frames before the recording ends so that the last frame always decodes; clamp every seek to playable_to_s. Chapter and event times are the full run timeline and are not clamped.
video.captions_time_base: run seconds (the clip plays at 1x, so they are also video seconds)
video.chapters_time_base: run seconds (the clip plays at 1x, so they are also video seconds)

pre_recording.label: Before the recording started
pre_recording.note: The agent was launched 4.04 s before the overhead recorder produced its first frame. Everything earlier than 0 s is clamped to 0 s and listed here.

exposes.commentary: yes, 8 progress messages plus 1 final report, verbatim
exposes.reasoning: titles only: 20 of the 23 reasoning items carried a one-line summary title; the reasoning text itself is not in the trace
exposes.tool_intent: no; the label on each shell command is derived from the command, not written by the agent
exposes.note: Codex CLI narrates as it goes but exposes only short reasoning titles.

privacy.scanned: Every image published here was inspected at full size. No face, screen, whiteboard, name tag, serial sticker or burned-in date appears in any of them.
privacy.hand_note: These stills are frames of the demonstration video and show the demonstrator's bare hand and forearm, with no face and no identifying feature. They are held for the privacy sign-off.
privacy.metadata: All stills re-encoded from the session frames; no EXIF, XMP or ICC block is carried over.

chapters.title: Read the interface, study the demonstration
Survey the scene, measure the parts
Pick up the hex part and seat it on its post
Check the first pair, approach the round part
Pick up the round part and seat it on its cylinder

events.text: I’ll read the interface and study the demonstration first, then inspect the live scene and assemble the two pairs in the workspace.

events.label: extract demo-video frames
events.cmd: ls goal && cat knowledge/tools/TOOLS.md && ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 goal/demo_top.mp4 && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -i goal/demo_top.mp4 -vf fps=1 scratch/demo_%03d.png

events.label: python analysis
events.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
paths=sorted(Path('scratch').glob('demo_*.png'))
out=Image.new('RGB',(1400,250*((len(paths)+3)//4)))
for i,p in enumerate(paths):
 im=Image.open(p).crop((850,350,1400,750)).resize((350,225)); x=(i%4)*350;y=(i//4)*250
 out.paste(im,(x,y));ImageDraw.Draw(out).text((x,y+225),p.name,fill='white')
out.save('scratch/demo_sheet.jpg')
PY
